vibe_rationale: Tightly curated, invitation-only art book fair with a design-led culture core, but a single scene in only its second edition.
fit_notes: Intimate, design-led crowd in a hotel setting suits a small lounge or hospitality partnership rather than scale. Exhibitors are invitation-only, a third edition is not yet announced, and wellness adjacency is weak. Tokyo-based, so an Australian brand would need a local partner.
